328
Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas July 31, 1883

Hon W.A. Saylor mayor Presiding

Roll call present aldermen Metz Lawrance
Kinney and Black
On motion the council was called
and the marshal sent after the absentees.
Call of the Council suspended
a fine of one dollar was entered against
Aldermen Schubert Pfannstielk Heuphertz
Morlan and Wilson for non attendance at
this meeting.
On motion the Council adjourned

T G Purnell
City Clerk
